bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-menu-a1b687d-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = a1b687d2982b05f6358974bc428a63a909f98ed1 || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - "$stage" <<'PY'
import ast,pathlib,re,sys,os
stage=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
text=(stage/"artifacts/bot/src/services/menuPanelRenderer.ts").read_text()
m=re.search(r'export const APPROVED_POSTING_ROWS = \[([\s\S]*?)\] as const;',text)
if not m:sys.exit(62)
rows=ast.literal_eval("["+m.group(1)+"]")
if [len(x) for x in rows]!=[3,2,2,3,1] or sum(map(len,rows))!=11:sys.exit(63)
p=pathlib.Path("scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py")
source=p.read_text()
tree=ast.parse(source)
matches=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="EXPECTED_MENU" for t in n.targets)]
if len(matches)!=1:sys.exit(64)
n=matches[0]
old=ast.literal_eval(n.value)
if old==rows:
 print("USERBOT_MENU_CONTRACT_ALREADY_CURRENT")
 sys.exit(0)
backup=pathlib.Path.home()/".local/state/tgtumbler/userbot-expected-menu-rollback-20261115.py"
backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if backup.exists():sys.exit(65)
with backup.open("x") as f:f.write(source)
os.chmod(backup,0o600)
lines=source.splitlines(keepends=True)
new="".join(lines[:n.lineno-1])+"EXPECTED_MENU = "+repr(rows)+"\n"+"".join(lines[n.end_lineno:])
ast.parse(new)
tmp=p.with_name(".userbot_resident_ipc.expected-menu.tmp")
with tmp.open("x") as f:f.write(new)
os.chmod(tmp,p.stat().st_mode&0o777)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print("USERBOT_STATIC_EXPECTED_MENU=ALIGNED")
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 66
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 67
sleep 5
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
PYTHONPATH=scripts timeout 72s python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio,sys
from userbot_test_client import invoke
from userbot_session import SESSION_BASE
from pathlib import Path
import stat
session=SESSION_BASE.with_suffix(".session")
if not session.is_file() or session.is_symlink() or stat.S_IMODE(session.stat().st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(69)
h=asyncio.run(invoke("health"))
if h.get("status")!="PASS" or h.get("authorized") is not True:sys.exit(70)
print("USERBOT_RESIDENT_AUTHORIZED=PASS")
r=asyncio.run(invoke("bot_start_menu"))
if r.get("status")!="PASS" or r.get("row_sizes")!=[3,2,2,3,1]:sys.exit(71)
print("USERBOT_LIVE_MENU=PASS")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
echo SHARED_MENU_LIVE_TEST=PASS
